artworks.title: Andrea Odoni
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: In the image, a man is depicted from the waist up, seated in a slightly reclined position, with his gaze directed outward toward the viewer. He has a full beard and long hair that falls to his shoulders, framing his face. His clothing consists of a textured robe with a fur collar and cuffs. He holds a small sculpted figure in his right hand while his left hand rests on his torso, partially beneath the robe. In front of him, on the table, are several coins scattered alongside what appears to be a closed book or document. Surrounding him are various sculptural artworks, including classical nude figures and busts, set against a plain background that highlights the fine details of both the man and the art pieces around him.

artworks.title: The Tide Rising at Briton Ferry
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Circle of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with a body of water, figures near the water's edge, and hills and mountains in the background. The painting features soft brushstrokes creating a gentle and dreamy quality. The color palette is muted with pastel tones dominating the scene. Clouds fill the sky with sunlight breaking through, illuminating parts of the landscape.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with a Bishop
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks: dark brown line block and two tone blocks in shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to and within border): 27.9 x 21.3 cm (11 x 8 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures in the upper body, with a woman holding a child as the primary focus. The woman's head is slightly bowed as she looks at the child she cradles. The woman has delicate facial features and her hair is covered by a draped cloth. The child appears naked and has soft hair. The woman wears flowing robes with intricate folds. Beside her stands a figure wearing a large mitre and holding a crozier, likely a bishop. The background is plain, with radiating lines around the woman's head.

artworks.title: At Donderen, in the Woods of Drenthe
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a ground-level view of a pastoral scene with a tree-lined pathway. A man with a hat and staff stands near a dog drinking from a stream on the left, while another figure with sheep is seen walking on the path in the distance. The trees are detailed with soft brushstrokes, and the color palette is earthy and muted. Natural light casts soft shadows over the landscape.

artworks.title: Federico Barocci
artworks.artist: Antoine Aubert after Jean-Baptiste Joseph Wicar after Federico Barocci
artworks.medium: engraving and stipple engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 27.3 x 19.8 cm (10 3/4 x 7 13/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person depicted from the chest up within an oval frame. The person is positioned facing slightly to the right while looking directly at the viewer. They have a prominent, bald forehead with short hair around the side of their head and a neatly trimmed beard. Their expression is solemn. The person is wearing a garment with a large, ruched, ruffled collar that extends all around their neck. The background consists of a lined texture, and the caption below identifies the individual as F. Baroche D'Urbin.

artworks.title: Figures in a Landscape [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures riding horses from a slightly elevated point of view. The sketch is done in ink with quick, fluid strokes on an off-white background. The composition includes riders, rocks, vegetation, and distant foliage, with a central focus on the horseback figures moving across the scene.

artworks.title: Figures in a Landscape [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the image, with structures and trees faintly sketched along it. The brushwork is loose and fluid, in what seems to be ink, creating quick, gestural strokes. The sketch suggests detail without emphasizing it. The color palette is mainly shades of brown ink on a cream background. Lines indicate figures, a cart or structure nearby, and the terrain and structures in the distance. The sky is filled with swirling lines implying cloud formations.

artworks.title: Head of a Cock
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rooster. It is an etching that focuses on the rooster's head, capturing detailed features such as its comb, wattle, and feather texture. The line work is delicate and precise, emphasizing the rooster's expression. The background is plain, directing attention to the rooster.

artworks.title: Coral Buntings and Their Nest in a Holly Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a round bird's nest with two small birds perched around it, surrounded by spiky, green holly leaves with red berries. The color palette includes earthy browns and whites of the birds, vibrant green of the holly leaves, and touches of red from the berries, against a soft, muted background. The nest is centrally placed with one bird perched near the top right of the nest and the other to the bottom left.

artworks.title: Gold Finches and Their Nest in an Apple Tree
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over gaphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image depicts two small birds interacting in a natural setting. One bird is perched atop a nest on a tree branch, while the other bird hovers nearby with a twig in its beak. The background shows blurred foliage and sky. The scene is painted in fine detail, with a color palette of greens, browns, soft pinks, and vibrant yellow.

artworks.title: Monument in a Church Cemetery
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a village churchyard with a medieval stone cross in the center. Around the cross are gravestones, and in the distance are church buildings with slate roofs and ivy-covered walls. The watercolor painting uses subtle brushstrokes to depict the stonework and foliage realistically. The color scheme is warm and earthy, with browns, grays, and hints of green. In the background, a tree and rolling hills can be seen under a pale sky.

artworks.title: Woman and a Crane (Vigilance?)
artworks.medium: soft-ground etching, drypoint, and graphite on thin wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a woman sitting with several animals around her. The woman appears relaxed, sitting with one arm supporting her weight and her legs extended. Her facial features are depicted in profile with simple lines. Her hair is tied back. She is wearing a long dress. Beside her is a sketch of a bird standing on one leg. Below, there are sketches of a lion's head, a partial human face similar to the woman, and a lioness. The background is plain. The drawing is signed and dated in the lower left corner.

artworks.title: Trees with a Low Building
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint with scraping on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with trees and a building. The horizon is low, with trees and a structure resembling a farmhouse or barn with a tower in the center. Large trees are on the left, and more structures are on the right. The painting has meticulous brushstrokes with varying shading for texture and depth, creating intricate details and a sense of movement in the trees and skies. The color palette is limited to black and gray, giving a moody, monochromatic visual impact that emphasizes the texture and detail in the landscape.

artworks.title: Ely Cathedral, Cambridgeshire, S.W. View
artworks.medium: graphite on heavy wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image is an architectural drawing of a grand, Gothic-style cathedral. The drawing showcases the cathedral from a slightly below viewpoint, emphasizing its height and intricate details. The perspective captures a side view of the cathedral, highlighting its depth and three-dimensional form. The horizon line is low, with the cathedral's towers and spires standing out. The structure is detailed with precise linework that defines its architecture, including pointed arches and carvings. The drawing is monochromatic, using shades of grey to convey depth and texture. In the background, trees and other architectural elements suggest a rural or park-like setting.

artworks.title: Welsh Hovel at Machynllaeth
artworks.medium: etching on chine applique
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic wooden building viewed straight on. The horizon line is low, with trees and the building dominating the view. The sky is cloudy, with fine line textures. The detailed composition uses cross-hatching and varied line density for shadows and highlights on the building's facade and trees. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of sepia or black and white. The weathered building and dense foliage are detailed.

artworks.title: Children in a Cart
artworks.medium: watercolor on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a rural scene with a white horse pulling a cart carrying four people (including children) through shallow water. A wooden bridge crosses the water, leading to a cottage next to a white picket fence on the right. Hills in the distance lead to the horizon, located one-third from the top. The painting has gentle, detailed brushstrokes, realistic blending, and a color palette of soft greens, browns, and muted pastels under a light blue sky.

artworks.title: View of Ullswater
artworks.medium: brush and black ink with gray washes over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with a slightly elevated point of view showing water and surrounding hills or mountains dominating the background. In the foreground, there is a flowing body of water with a small boat containing two figures. Close by, there is a small structure partially hidden by trees. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a misty atmosphere. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and sepia, giving a serene and timeless feel. The brushwork provides texture, especially in the trees and foliage.

artworks.title: Five Sheep
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of five sheep in various poses. The detailed pencil renderings capture the texture and shapes of each sheep. Two sheep are shown standing side by side facing left, while the other three have their backs turned. Fine lines and shading are used to depict the woolly coats of the sheep, with a minimalistic background.

artworks.title: Studies of Sheep
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several sheep in various positions. The drawing features multiple sketches of sheep, each captured in a different posture. One sheep lies down with its eyes closed, seemingly at rest. Another sketch depicts a sheep's head from a frontal angle, capturing the texture of its wool and facial expression. Additionally, one sheep is shown standing, captured at an angle that highlights its side profile. The drawing uses light shading and fine lines to convey the softness of the wool and the gentle forms of the sheep, without any background elements.

artworks.title: Studies of Cattle
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple cows in various poses. There are sketches of cows shown standing, lying down, and in different positions, each captured with detail in musculature and facial features. The use of fine pencil lines and shading creates a realistic appearance of the cows' fur and body forms. The arrangement suggests a study of the animals in nature, focusing on capturing their poses and shapes.

artworks.title: Three Horses in a Field
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 12.3 x 17.1 cm (4 13/16 x 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows three horses in a pasture, with two standing and one lying down under a tree. The horizon is visible in the background, with trees and the sky filling the upper part of the composition. The horses are detailed with fine, dense lines to depict texture and shadow, emphasizing their bodies' volume and musculature. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black typical of an etching. Trees overhead and sketchy outlines contribute to the pastoral atmosphere of the scene.

artworks.title: Rade de Bordeaux
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of the harbor in Bordeaux from a slightly elevated angle. The horizon is high in the image, where the river meets the sky, with a faint line of buildings and distant ships. Along the left are buildings extending along the shoreline, with rooftops creating a continuous line. Ships with tall masts are docked along the water's edge to the right. Fine and detailed brushstrokes emphasize architectural structures, ships, and dock activity. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, white, and gray. Figures are depicted walking along the quay, engaging in various activities, and a horse-drawn carriage adds to the bustling atmosphere.

artworks.title: Way into Abergavenny from Llanfoist
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The image shows a country landscape with a dirt path winding through it. On the left are trees with green and golden leaves, a house with chimneys visible through the foliage, and hills in the background. The color palette includes warm earth tones and muted colors in the distance, blending into the sky. There is a woman and a child walking on the path and a flock of sheep grazing on the green slope to the right. The brushstrokes are delicate and detailed, depicting light and shadow.

artworks.title: Squirrel Lane, near Magham Down, Sussex
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sight size: 22.5 x 33.9 cm (8 7/8 x 13 3/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John Nichols Estabrook and Dorothy Coogan Estabrook
artworks.description: The painting shows an elevated view of a rural landscape with a dirt path sloping downwards. In the background are rolling hills merging with a blue-gray sky. On the path, there is a flock of sheep being herded and to the right, a woman and a child picking berries. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing the textures of foliage and the path realistically. The color palette includes warm earthy tones of greens, browns, and yellows, contrasting with the blue hills and subtle sky. Sunlight creates patches of light on the landscape.
